summary.key_theme: Quanta Services 受惠於 AI 資料中心建設帶來的龐大電力基礎設施需求，市場普遍看好其長期成長潛力與財務表現。

bullish.title: Big Tech Will Spend $735 Billion on Data Centers. This Boring Electrical Contractor Collects the Checks.
bullish.reason: 強調 Quanta Services 作為超大規模資料中心建設的關鍵受益者，直接受惠於科技巨頭高達 7,350 億美元的資本支出。

bullish.title: 2 Growth Stocks With Strong Earnings Prospects to Buy in October
bullish.reason: 將 Quanta Services 與 NVIDIA 並列為具備強勁獲利成長前景與良好估值趨勢的成長股。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR) Sets Up for Breakout With 8/8 Technical and Setup Ratings
bullish.reason: 技術指標顯示該股具備強勁的趨勢動能與優質的設定，暗示股價有進一步突破的潛力。

bullish.title: Is Quanta Services (PWR) a Solid Growth Stock? 3 Reasons to Think "Yes"
bullish.reason: 分析指出公司財務表現優於平均水準，具備長期成長的結構性優勢。

bullish.title: Quanta Services: A Powerful Growth Platform With Little Room For Execution Errors
bullish.reason: 肯定公司多元化的基礎設施平台，並強調其在 AI 驅動需求下的強大競爭地位。

bullish.title: GE Vernova (GEV) vs. Quanta Services (PWR): Which AI Power Stock Has More Room to Run?
bullish.reason: 探討 AI 帶動的電力需求如何使 Quanta Services 成為關鍵受惠者，並與同業進行比較。

bullish.title: Can Quanta's Electric Business Drive Further Margin Expansion?
bullish.reason: 探討公司電力業務的利潤率擴張潛力，關注輸電工程與勞動力利用率的影響。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Outperforms Broader Market
bullish.reason: 反映近期股價表現強勁，單日上漲 2.11%，顯示市場買盤積極。

bearish.title: Piper Sandler Maintains Overweight on Quanta Services, Lowers Price Target to $714
bearish.reason: 儘管維持「加碼」評級，但下調目標價至 714 美元，可能反映對短期估值或執行風險的謹慎態度。

bearish.title: Why Quanta Services (PWR) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
bearish.reason: 報導股價單日下跌 1.42%，反映市場短期的獲利了結或波動。

neutral.title: Powerfleet Unity Recognized for End-to-End AIoT Innovation Across Enterprise Operations
neutral.reason: 此新聞提及的是代碼為 AIOT 的 Powerfleet 公司，與 Quanta Services (PWR) 無關，屬於誤報或代碼混淆。
